in_sanskrit.name: Ansarul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lion-protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ansarul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ansarul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ansar' which means 'lion'. The suffix 'ul' denotes 'protector' or 'ruler'. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and leadership. It is a powerful and protective name for a baby boy in Hindu tradition.
